bodyHtml:
AQUASKY has successfully passed the KC certification annual audit.

KC certification or called Korea certification ensures the conformity of products to safety standards. The goal of the KC certification is to prevent and reduce the risks of safety, health, or impact on the environment.

 

The KC mark is similar to the European CE mark. It is valid for 730 different products such as automotive parts, machines and many electronic products. The test mark confirms the products meet the relevant Korean Safety Standard.

 

Products without the KC mark may have no access to South Korea or can be subject to penalties.
